These local browser libraries are loaded by the script and stylesheet tags in index.html. Application code lives in js/ and exercises/.

| Files | Upstream package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| xterm.js, xterm.css | @xterm/xterm | 5.5.0 |
| addon-fit.js | @xterm/addon-fit | 0.10.0 |
| addon-web-links.js | @xterm/addon-web-links | 0.11.0 |
| bash.js | just-bash browser distribution, with fflate for gzip support | 3.6.0, 0.8.3 |
| yaml.js | js-yaml | 4.1.1 |
| marked.js | marked | 12.0.2 |

The adjacent LICENSE files accompany these distributions.
